stories.title: ¿Por qué se celebra el Día del Novio en México, HOY 3 de octubre?; conoce el significado de regalar flores azules

en.title: Why is Boyfriend's Day celebrated in Mexico, TODAY October 3rd?; learn the meaning of giving blue flowers

stories.title: Así cerraron Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro sus campañas antes de la primera vuelta electoral en Brasil

en.summary: Spain maintained its perfect performance in the UEFA Nations League by defeating the Czech Republic.

en.summary: Thousands of social media users claimed to be "Jane Doe" after a journalist requested the former student's name be revealed, following a reopened investigation into the alleged assault.
